method.fixtures: two deterministic RGB PNG patterns, 974x974, pinned CLIP publisher assets
notes: One capacity container at a time. Some cold-guard replay overlapped small QA validation on the shared host.
Observations are not paired throughput benchmarks; host load, first-touch costs and page-cache charging vary.
Shared file pages may be charged elsewhere; cgroup values can be lower than process RSS. No host cache flush.
Process/controller lifetime peaks differ from sampled stage peaks; absent counters remain unknown.
No CUDA or Intel GPU VRAM, all concurrent HTTP-input combinations, or GitHub-hosted workflow execution measured.
Guarded intermediate images used a 30-second default; final API images use 45. Image identities are recorded.
